title: Surreal Cosmic Kitchen
description: A translucent ghostly figure stands in a dilapidated green kitchen reaching toward a bright yellow refrigerator covered in alien stickers. Through the window a surreal alien landscape is visible with a large red planet, purple fields, and a crystal ball on the counter containing miniature floating figures.
prompt: A surreal scene inside a dilapidated green kitchen with dripping counters and alien stickers on a bright yellow refrigerator. A translucent ghostly human figure reaches toward the fridge. On the counter sits a crystal ball containing miniature floating figures. Through a stained glass window an alien landscape is visible featuring a giant red planet, purple hills, and strange creatures under a black starry sky with white swirling lines.
